name: ne-memory
description: Find repeated Copilot corrections and turn them into reusable rules, with a five-second review window.

ne.scope.markdownDescription: Legacy scan scope setting. Use `ne.scanAllWorkspaces` for new configurations.

ne.scanAllWorkspaces.description: Scan every VS Code workspace under the local workspaceStorage directory. Disabled by default.

ne.minimumSessions.description: Minimum number of different chat sessions required before a correction is treated as repeated.

ne.maxSessions.description: Maximum number of recent chat session files to inspect.

ne.defaultScope.description: Initial rule registration target. Review mode can switch the scope.

ne.autoRegisterSeconds.description: Seconds before a proposed rule is registered automatically.

commands.title: Ne: Analyze Corrections and Save a Rule
